text:
maria: quick heads-up, starting heatprobe rollout for inference-runtime v2.14.0 to 3% in eu-west.
deploy-bot: Deployment started by @maria — canary target: 3% traffic (pods: runtime-v2.14.0-canary) — thread_ts=1719998881
sam: noted, I'll watch sentinels. Can we hold on pinning older version until metrics settle?
chen: watching latency and error-rate dashboards https://internal.redwood/boards/heatprobe-eu-west — alerting rules ready.
ops-oncall: oncall here — will ping if error-rate > 1.5% or p50 > 1200ms. please set alert thresholds for this rollout window.
maria: sounds good. setting alert: errors>1.5% OR p50>1200ms for next 20m
deploy-bot: Autoscale warmup ok. Preflight checks:
```
- KV cache health: OK
- GPU temp: OK
- AMs: 2 failed healthchecks in eu-west-1, restarting
```
sam: seeing a small spike in 5xx from /v1/embeddings, 3 errors at 10:42
chen: rolling logs show OOMs in node64 under heavy batching; might be an edge in the quantized path.
jane: @maria recommend pause? we should roll back to v2.13.7 if errors > 10 in 5m
maria: deciding stop/go — we have ~5m left on probe window. calling quick vote: react with :thumbsup: for GO, :thumbsdown: for STOP.
sam: :thumbsdown: (stop)
ops-oncall: :thumbsdown:
chen: :thumbsdown: (OOMs reproduced on two samples)
maria: votes lean STOP. I'm going to pin routing to previous stable and trigger rollback.
deploy-bot: Initiating traffic shift: canary 3% -> 0% over 30s. Rolling back to inference-runtime v2.13.7. Rollback reason: elevated 5xx and OOMs in canary pods.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. All canary pods drained. Routing pinned to runtime v2.13.7.
maria: thanks team. Filing release note: "heatprobe v2.14.0 halted — rollback due to OOMs on embed path; follow-up: reproduce with load test #heatprobe-03 and add memory guardrails"
sam: I'll open an infra ticket (ENG-RUN-4893) and assign to eng-runtime for investigation.
chen: collecting logs, heap profiles and flamegraphs now, will attach repro and a small reproducer script.
maria: I'll schedule a follow-up postmortem sync tomorrow at 11:00 to decide next steps and whether we need a micro-release.
ops-oncall: monitoring the cluster for the next 15m and will escalation if anything else pops.
maria: closing this thread after 30m. if anyone sees residual errors or anomalous traces, please ping here or reopen.
